payload.taskDescription: Create CardListPage at /case/:caseId/list and CardListPanel with grouped cards, title, type, and topic-status slot. Add Add, Edit, Open detail, and Delete actions. Replace the case placeholder's empty state with EmptyBoard offering note, source, and topic capture. Implement deleteCard and a useUndoDelete hook: confirmation names the affected string count, deletion removes the card, connections, and attachments immediately, and an 8-second toast can restore the snapshot including attachments. Clear the snapshot on timeout or a second delete; no redo. Wire routes and links from the board. Do not add connection creation here.
